title: In This Town, Something Knocks With Your Dad's Voice

lines.text: In this town, something knocks on your door at night,
using the voices of the people you love.
So every family has a secret knock.
And you never open the door without it.
Nobody knows what it is. We just call it the Mimic.
Mr. Hale once opened his door for his wife's voice.
His wife was asleep upstairs.
His door closed by itself.
So we practise our knocks on our palms, never on wood.
Because if it hears your knock, it learns it.
Ours was two slow, three fast.
One evening, I got locked out after dark.
I panicked, and I knocked it. Loud.
And from the trees behind me,
something knocked it back.
Dad's face went white when I told him.
It knows our knock now. I'll make us a new one.
He worked on it all evening, then left for his night shift.
At midnight, someone knocked.
Two slow. Three fast.
Mia, it's Dad. I forgot my keys.
But that was our old knock.
So I didn't move.
It begged. Then it went quiet.
Then, a different knock.
One I'd never heard.
Mia, it's me! I saw it by the house! That's the new knock, open the door!
But I didn't know the new knock.
So I didn't open it.
One heavy thud. Then nothing.
In the morning, Dad's keys were on the doorstep.
And on the kitchen table was a note in his handwriting.
Our new knock, written down for me.
I never checked.
Dad left the new knock on the kitchen table.
Tonight, something outside is knocking it.
